why: Authored because the production case recorded for this hazard could NOT be reproduced. FA/EK-R-19 does not exist as a message on either environment (HTTP 204), the dma-fa series holds 32 messages under 32 distinct shortIds rather than the recorded 357 under 331, and no series on either environment carries a duplicated shortId at all. The hazard is still real -- shortId is not declared unique and nothing prevents reuse -- so it is pinned synthetically rather than left untested or backed by a fixture that does not reproduce.
pins: M-1. Member comparison is keyed on uid, never shortId. Keyed on shortId these two sets look identical; keyed on uid they differ by one member in each direction.
